title: eGamma-VBA: an expanded Gamma distribution library for Microsoft Excel

creators.name: Drevland, Frode
creators.affiliation: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

description:
eGamma-VBA implements the expanded Gamma distribution for Microsoft Excel: a three-parameter Gamma distribution whose scale parameter is allowed to be negative, so that the density is reflected about its location parameter and can represent left-skewed as well as right-skewed data. In that form the family is Pearson Type III, expressed in the Gamma distribution's own shape, scale and location parameters. Excel provides no three-parameter Gamma distribution among its built-in functions, which has been a practical obstacle to using the family in spreadsheet work at all.

The library is distributed as an add-in and as an importable module, and exposes its functionality as worksheet functions: EGAMMA_DIST and EGAMMA_INV for the density, distribution and quantile functions; EGAMMA_MEAN, EGAMMA_MODE, EGAMMA_MEDIAN, EGAMMA_VAR, EGAMMA_STDDEV, EGAMMA_SKEW and EGAMMA_KURT for the moments; EGAMMA_TPE_TO_PARAMS to fit the distribution to a three-point estimate, where a low, most likely and high value are supplied and the outer two are interpreted at a chosen pair of symmetric percentiles; and EGAMMA_FIT_TO_PARAMS to fit it to a sample. The three-point routine is intended for probabilistic cost and schedule analysis, where estimates elicited from experts must be turned into distributions that a Monte Carlo simulation can sample.

It matches the Python implementation, eGamma, against a shared set of conformance test vectors. The release archive contains the add-in, the module source and the manual as a PDF.

Source code: github.com/FrodeDrevland/EGAMMA-VBA
